attempt1: Propose the full past-due amount (or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week, or of next week if today is that day, capped at the deadline.

opening.text: Hello, I am a virtual assistant from Nordhavn Bank, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Nordhavn Bank's virtual assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning the number on the back of your card or on nordhavn.example.

failed_id.text: I cannot continue; please visit a branch or use online banking.

paid_reply.text: Payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I do not have that information.

id_reason.text: These questions are there to protect your account.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Could you please say the month as a word?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, just to be sure: am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: A confirmation of this promise will be sent to you by text message.

forbidden_before_verify: product name (credit card, overdraft, personal loan)

extra_rules.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms identity; hello, go ahead, who is this do not. Answer a customer question first; the next ask is the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: When someone else answers, do not say why you are calling; say nothing beyond the opening sentence and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence.

extra_rules.statement: Callback must be today or the next business day, 09:00-18:00 inclusive, and later than now. If the offered time is outside, ask once more; if still outside, do not schedule and close not_reached/no_callback.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If that is also outside it, do not schedule.

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions

extra_rules.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD; read a date given only in numbers as day, month, year; send four digits for phone_last4.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: A day_month_swapped hint retry (ask for month as a word) does not count as a wrong answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers do not state the debt; tell the customer to visit a branch or use online banking and close not_verified/failed.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer declines to answer, explain once that the questions protect the account; asking what the call is about counts as declining; a second refusal or second such question closes not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after every security question passes; name the product in words (credit card ending NNNN, overdraft, personal loan) and state overdue_amount and days_past_due.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A weekend or holiday not after the deadline: offer the next business day. A date after the deadline: say the latest recordable date is the deadline and offer it; refusal is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: A vague period: ask once for the exact day; if none, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Ask for the full amount first; never ask 'how much can you pay?'. If full is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusal is a flat refusal. Customer amounts from floor to full are accepted; below floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once, otherwise flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount the customer proposes is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal. When attempts are used up, stop, do not repeat a refused offer, close no_promise/refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion attempt, offer support team transfer; accept -> transfer support and close transferred/support; decline -> no_promise/hardship. If the customer still names a date or amount, record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask 'Do you confirm?'; call create_promise only after a clear yes. If the customer changes date/amount, re-check and read back again. One promise per product; cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true; if it fails, retry once; if it fails again say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: 'I already paid': say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, close paid.
extra_rules.brief_quote: payments can take one business day to appear

extra_rules.statement: Dispute (not mine, never had product, closed/paid off in the past): do not argue, no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: Request for new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan; transfer to restructuring and close transferred/restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: Request for a human: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist transfer to queue general and close transferred/human. Applies before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once whether you can help first

extra_rules.statement: Asked whether it is a robot/AI: say you are Nordhavn Bank's virtual assistant and continue. Asked if scam: say they can verify by phoning the number on the back of their card or on nordhavn.example, and continue.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Is this a scam?

extra_rules.statement: A question not answerable from the tools: say you do not have that information; do not invent figures, dates or reasons.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk, close no_promise/refused; before verification close not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call, last tool call; thank the customer and say goodbye before it. If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: All date rules use the call variable now, not the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

extra_rules.statement: The brief does not state the product_id format.
A vague date has no exact day. Ask once for the day. If there is still none, offer the deadline from the facts.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks for a new payment plan, a restructuring, or lower instalments. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: The **floor** is `min_due` for a credit card or an overdraft, and `monthly_instalment` for a personal loan.
examples: The **floor** is `min_due` for a credit card or an overdraft, and `monthly_instalment` for a personal loan.
Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.
If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks to speak to a person. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: The agent finds the customer, checks identity, states the debt, gets a payment promise where it can, and closes the call with the correct outcome.
examples: The agent finds the customer, checks identity, states the debt, gets a payment promise where it can, and closes the call with the correct outcome.
If the customer asks whether you are a robot or an AI, say that you are Nordhavn Bank's virtual assistant and continue.

extra_rules.statement: The customer names a hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.
examples: If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.
